responsibility: Implements structural hashing for RTL expressions. The inchash::add_rtx routine walks an rtx, incorporating code, mode, constants, registers, vectors, strings, and nested operands into an incremental hash while intentionally treating certain nodes like labels, scratch values, and some debug forms specially, so that middle-end and backend components can build stable hash keys for RTL-based memoization and comparison.
same_name_distinction: Implements the structural hashing walk for RTL in inchash::add_rtx, deciding how different rtx codes, operands, vectors, and strings contribute to a hash; unlike gcc/rtlhash.h, it contains the traversal and hashing behavior rather than only the exported declaration.
